6. Notes and further results

6.1. References.                                                
        The proof of the theorem of M. Riesz first appeared in Sur les fonctions

conjuguees (Math. Zeit. 27 (1927), 218-244) but had been announced earlier
      in Les fonctions conjuguees et les series de Fourier (C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris
      178 (1924), 1464-1467). The proof in the text became possible only after
      the Marcinkiewicz interpolation theorem appeared in 1939. See Section 6.3

below for the original proof by Riesz and another one due to M. Cotlar
      (A unified theory of Hilbert transforms and ergodic theorems, Rev. Mat.
      Cuyana 1 (1955), 105-167). Additional proofs due to A. P. Calderon (On
